Bring existing notes into the planner without reorganizing your vault.

**Add and remove from the file explorer**

- Right-click a Markdown note and choose **Add note to planner…**. Review its date, thread and exact property changes before saving. The original file stays where it is; no duplicate is created.
- An included note offers **Show in planner** and **Remove note from planner…**. The card menu also offers removal.
- Removal deletes only `planner_type: entry`. The note, date, calendar properties, title, thread, connections and body are retained. Undo and Redo cover both adding and removing.

**Drag and drop existing notes**

- Drop onto a thread header or notebook thread to keep the valid existing date.
- Drop onto a day cell to propose that day and thread.
- Every explorer drop opens a review. If the date changes, it warns that calendars using the same property will also reflect the change. Cancel writes nothing.
- One existing Markdown note from this vault at a time is supported. Existing cards are updated instead of duplicated. Normal dragging of cards already on the board still reschedules them directly.

**Upgrading: folders now choose storage only**

The old **Planner folder** scope is removed. **Threads folder** and **New entries folder** are now full, vault-relative creation paths. Older base and child paths are combined to preserve the existing destinations; files are not moved. Entries and threads already marked with `planner_type` are found anywhere, including outside the former scope. Unmarked notes remain excluded even if they have dates; Show all dated notes stays removed.

The Zoom in/out toolbar buttons are removed; **Day width** remains configurable in settings. The README and settings explain the new workflow and migration.

Requires Obsidian 1.10.2 or later. Install `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` below. GitHub Actions builds, checks, attests and verifies all three files before publication.
